justification: Both reliefs use profile human and animal figures rendered in low relief, a shared general convention of the depiction style, but the actual subject matter diverges sharply: A shows a dynamic hunting/combat scene with a chariot-borne archer trampling a fallen beast, while B shows a static horizontal procession of standing/walking figures and a single led animal among trees. The compositional logic—dynamic diagonal action versus repetitive marching frieze—differs fundamentally, so the correspondence is limited to generic figural conventions rather than shared iconography.
